parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more rigorous personalization (specific tax math, catch-up contribution analysis, inflation-adjusted retirement income projections) and stronger factual grounding with fewer questionable claims (System A's Rec #3 miscalculates a $88K monthly surplus and Rec #4 suggests adding new individual dividend stocks which conflicts with de-risking). System B's TIPS recommendation directly addresses an inflation gap relevant to the 10-year glide path, and its actions include more precise dollar amounts and cadence, though System A better addresses existing sector concentration.
